title: RM92mil beef-up for KL flood mitigation system | The Star
text:
RM92mil beef-up for KL flood mitigation system | The Star
KUALA LUMPUR: Some RM92mil will be spent to improve the city's flash flood mitigation system after thousands were affected earlier this month.
Deputy Federal Territories Minister Datuk Dr J. Loga Bala Mohan said the money will be used to replace old piping, install water pumps and build retention ponds and road diversions.
